name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in June 2000, Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited is a health-tech and insurance-tech company that manages health benefits for employers, retail members, and public health schemes, primarily serving insurance companies.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] Company provides third-party administration (TPA) services to insurance companies through its wholly-owned Subsidiaries, Medi Assist TPA, Medvantage TPA, and Raksha TPA. A third-party administrator is an organization that processes health insurance claims for insurance companies and provides services such as policy administration, customer service, and network management, among others.

cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -15.9%
